summary: Baileys fork with char-code-obfuscated hardcoded network destination in message-send path
details: diezyyasha-baileys is a fork of the WhatsApp Web (Baileys) library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js constructs a hardcoded destination URL via String.fromCharCode over a decimal-ASCII array; the array decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The destination is embedded inside the socket message-send code path — a location that handles caller message content and session context — and the host is reconstructed via character-code obfuscation rather than appearing as a plain literal. Obfuscated destinations in a messaging-library send path are inconsistent with the upstream Baileys project, which sends only to WhatsApp servers, and are consistent with covert exfiltration of caller-supplied data or session artifacts to a third-party host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
